'''Melvirre''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who worked with [[Caira]]. While at lunch on [[Terman Station]], Caira enthusiastically pointed out [[Kucha-sculpt|''kucha''-sculpts]] that decorated the walls, commenting that they would be worth a fortune if real. Uncomfortable with the attention they were attracted, Melviree despaired that he had partnered with an expert in [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] folklore and culture.<ref name="SSR" />
